definitions.fig-service-users: count of contracting parties (person/legal entity) currently served; always exclude test accounts, internal accounts, staff, trials and LOIs
definitions.fig-title-deeds: count of title-deed (โฉนดที่ดิน) records in the same universe; if other deed types cannot be separated, count them but change the wording to เอกสารสิทธิ์
definitions.fig-land-area: sum of deed area in the same universe, converted to whole ไร่, rounded down
definitions.fig-land-value: total value of land only, no structures, on one single price basis (never mixed); parcels with no recorded value are excluded
